primary_estimate: 100 times each arm's measured complete first-epoch setup, training, internal validation and FP32 save duration
component_estimate: Also report loader, non-optimizer batch time, actual update count, validation and save components. Adjusted update-count estimates are sensitivity analysis, not an exact runtime forecast.
unmeasured_targeted_arm: Do not assume zero augmentation cost or a measured ALL_FIVE runtime.
research_evaluation_reserve: Two arms times21 frozen contexts times the largest verified historical YOLO26s1280 complete-context wall time, including saved COCO replay and bootstrap cost
checkpoint_disk_estimate: 200 times the measured full-epoch FP32 snapshot size, plus evaluation artifacts and the5GiB reserve
required_fit: Both full arms, evaluation reserve and storage must fit the smaller of cumulative worker time remaining and the unchanged absolute allocation deadline.
non_admission: A fit estimate does not itself implement or authorize an unreviewed formal entry. Any failed health, source, protocol or count gate blocks that branch.
if_no_fit: RESOURCE_BLOCKED. Do not shorten epochs, change resolution, omit validation or disable health checks.
